newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Retailer Sears attracts large trade.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Retailer Sears attracts large trade.

text.p: A huge trade of options in retailer Sears Plc enlived the stock options market on Wednesday, though traders said they did not know who was behind the deal in the usually quiet stock.
Some 1,125 contracts were traded in December 90 calls, just a month before Sears options cease to trade, helping push Sears cash shares up 2-1/2p to 92-1/2 by 1441 GMT.

Elsewhere British Telecommunications options were busy with trading including what appeared to be a straddle in the November 360 puts and calls. Some 1,809 November calls were traded and volume in the November puts reached 2,534 contracts.
